result.reason: The targeted insertion is limited and preserves unrelated terms, but it does not achieve either playbook position. Article XIII still expressly disclaims Licensor liability for infringement claims and caps all Licensor liability at one-half of fees, undermining the new indemnity. The redline also leaves Licensee's indemnity far broader than Customer-provided content and breach of law, adds no indemnity procedures, and includes none of the fallback IP exclusions, remedies, or 3× annual-fees super-cap. The margin comment identifies the issue but the operative language does not resolve it.
